$schema: hand-maintained; tools/fidelity/run.mjs fails the build on any corpus key missing from both lists
$rules: handled  = the key has a real representation in packages/core/src/model/types.ts
ignored  = we consciously drop it; the reason says exactly what fidelity is lost
Do not move a key to handled to silence the gate. Add the field to types.ts first.

handled.librevenge:rotate: Base.rotation; degrees despite the 'in' unit tag (IR.md unit table)
handled.draw:fill: selects Fill.type: none | solid | gradient | image (value 'bitmap')
handled.draw:fill-image: base64 bytes -> Doc.assets entry referenced by Fill.image.assetRef
handled.draw:stroke: Stroke presence; 'dash' selects the dashed branch
handled.svg:d[].librevenge:path-action: PathCommand.op (M L C Q A Z all present in the model)
handled.fo:column-gap: TextBox.columns.gap; the column *count* is not in the stream and is inferred
handled.fo:line-height: Paragraph.lineHeight; multiplier despite the '%' unit tag
handled.style:text-underline-style: Run.underline (boolean); dotted/dash/wave variants flatten to a plain underline
handled.style:text-position: Run.baselineShift (first component); the size-scale second component is dropped
handled.dc:title: DocMeta.title
handled.dc:creator: DocMeta.creator
handled.dc:subject: DocMeta.subject

ignored.svg:fill-rule: No fill rule in Geometry. Only value in the corpus is 'nonzero', which is the SVG/PDF default, so nothing is lost today; a future 'evenodd' would silently change self-intersecting shapes.
ignored.svg:stroke-linecap: No linecap in Stroke. Only value in the corpus is 'butt', the SVG default.
ignored.draw:fill-image-ref-point: Fill.image has repeat but no anchor. Only value in the corpus is 'top-left', the default anchor.
ignored.fo:text-scale: Horizontal glyph scaling (80% seen once). No Run field; text renders at natural width and the line gets wider.
ignored.fo:text-shadow: Per-run text shadow ('1pt 1pt', seen once). Shadow exists on ShapeStyle but not on Run; dropped.
ignored.style:text-outline: Outlined glyphs (seen once). No Run field; renders as solid fill.
ignored.style:font-relief: Embossed/engraved glyphs (seen twice). No Run field; renders flat.
ignored.draw:color-mode: Greyscale image filter. Fill.image carries no colour transform; the image renders in original colour.
ignored.draw:red: Per-channel image colour adjustment. No Fill.image field; dropped.
ignored.draw:green: Per-channel image colour adjustment. No Fill.image field; dropped.
ignored.draw:blue: Per-channel image colour adjustment. No Fill.image field; dropped.
ignored.libmspub:shade: Gradient shading style. Fill.gradient is linear-only (angle + stops), so 'center' (radial) degrades to a linear ramp.
ignored.librevenge:category: DocMeta has no category field. Metadata only; no visual loss.

handled.setStyle: latches the ShapeStyle applied to the next draw* or text object
handled.insertSpace: a space appended to the current Run
handled.insertTab: a tab appended to the current Run
handled.insertLineBreak: a hard break appended to the current Run

ignored.startLayer: types.ts has no layer; layers flatten into Page.elements in stream order. Publisher z-order is preserved, layer identity is not.

documentedButAbsent.drawRectangle: in docs/IR.md's vocabulary but never emitted by this corpus; libmspub sends rectangles as drawPolygon
documentedButAbsent.drawEllipse: in docs/IR.md's vocabulary but never emitted by this corpus; ellipses arrive as drawPath arcs
documentedButAbsent.drawGraphicObject: in docs/IR.md's vocabulary but never emitted by this corpus; images arrive as a bitmap draw:fill-image on setStyle
documentedButAbsent.openGroup: in docs/IR.md's vocabulary but never emitted by this corpus
documentedButAbsent.closeGroup: in docs/IR.md's vocabulary but never emitted by this corpus
